fields.statement: QA at 433db495 with the built binary (rhiza tui app inbox) in tmux on scratch repos made by testscripts with fake rex/claude. Question item: Enter opens a one-TextArea form; an empty Enter shows 'an answer needs words' and the form stays live; typing 'Use sqlite' and Enter calls session.message and, with no session S1 in the fake, shows 'send failed: no session matches "S1"' in a fresh live form that accepts typing again; Esc then quits (exit 0) with nothing sent. Blocker item: empty Enter refused, then 'Use a file' + Enter wrote Decision answer-store-q (quote 'Use a file', answers store-q) into the blocker's change set via question.answer and the app exited 0. Cycle 1's frozen-form finding is fixed.

QA at 433db495 with the built binary in tmux on a real review run stopped at signoff (testscript scratch repo, fake claude): Enter opens 'Sign off · Approve me' with the run ID, what it waits for and 'a approve · s send back · esc close'. 's' opens a note form; an empty Enter shows 'a send-back needs a note'; 'tighten the tests' + Enter journalled 'signoff (visit 1): changes' with finding 'alpha f1 major at owner: tighten the tests' and the app exited 0. On a fresh copy 'a' journalled 'approved by test', queued the run in continues.json, the signoff left rhiza inbox and the app exited 0.

QA at 433db495: send-back from the built inbox app on a real review run waiting at signoff journalled the note as a finding; rhiza run status lists it under Sign-offs as 'changes asked by test' with 'alpha f1 major at owner: tighten the tests', and no approval is journalled. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(run-send-back|inbox-signoff)$' passes.

QA at 433db495 with the built binary in tmux: on a failed run Enter opens 'What to do with the run' with a Retry/Abandon Select; Abandon then the Confirm left at its default No re-showed the choice ('abandon needs the confirm') with the journal unchanged; Esc quit with nothing done; Abandon then Yes appended finished 'abandoned by test' and exited 0. On a real failed review run (fake claude exiting 1) Retry queued it in continues.json with retry:true and exited 0. On a skipped run (change set landed) the same Select shows and Retry surfaces run.resume's refusal ('is not resumed: its change set ... is landed') in a live form. Neither choice shows on question, signoff, blocker, accept or open items.

QA at 433db495 with the built binary in tmux on testscript scratch repos: one List row per item in rhiza inbox order with kind, change set title, step and what it waits for (failed, question, signoff, blocker, disk-low; skipped and accept; open); rhiza tui app inbox --once is byte-identical (cmp) to rhiza inbox --json on the accept and open repos; an empty inbox shows 'Nothing waits on you'. Enter opens the action on question, blocker, signoff, failed, skipped and accept (Confirm, default No; Yes accepted the change set and it left the inbox); Enter on disk-low shows its detail view. But on an open (gate) item from a real stopped plan run, the per-question form submits question.answer against the main repo and the run's record change set and always fails ('answer failed: no question "park-disk"'): the parked question lives only in the plan run's worktree and planned change set, so a gate can never be answered from the app.
